content: Make me slither.io app but instead of snakes it's lizards. Include inputs to change aspects of the game that is useful. Have ambient music and sound effects.

Please remove the map overlay and stick a small mini map in the top left corner. Also make left click a boost, not working right now. Refactor the death process so we don't open a new window saying you've died. Recreate the on death re-spawn window so that it's a window inside the Iframe

✨ Refinement ready for index.html!

• REPLACE lines 30-92: Moved minimap to top-left, scoreboard to top-right, and added styles for the new in-iframe Game Over screen.
• INSERT line 108: Added the Game Over screen HTML structure.
• REPLACE line 125: Reduced boost cost from 0.5 to 0.05 per tick. Previously, boosting drained length too fast (30 units/sec), causing the player to vanish instantly.
• INSERT line 141: Added JavaScript references for the new UI elements.
• REPLACE lines 527-530: Refactored death logic to show the internal Game Over screen instead of using window.alert().
• INSERT line 653: Wired up the 'Play Again' button.
• REPLACE line 673: Ensured the Game Over screen is hidden when the game restarts.

👆 Review the diff and **Save** or **Discard** the changes.
